note: Everything the caller says appears in his speech bubble, whether or not the voice is on. Numbers without a nickname are read digit by digit and then in full, for example 'Four and seven, forty-seven'. This is a starter list of traditional calls with the ruder ones left out; edit freely. On Quick speed he drops the nicknames and just says the number.

tooSlow: Too slow! The next number is out.
checking: Let's have a look at that card.
win: Every number checks out. We have a winner!

notCalled: Ooh, unlucky. I haven't called {number} yet.
usedOnOtherCard: Not quite. {number} is already on your other card.
noPattern: I can't see {pattern} there, I'm afraid.

pause: No peeking! Your cards are covered.

_introNote: 'intro' lines are the welcome the caller says before the first number. The game shuffles them and plays them all before any repeats. The player is always 'you' in speech, never their typed name.

callOverrides.note: Calls that should be said as one phrase, exactly as written, instead of 'number, nickname'. Used when nicknames are on (Relaxed and Steady). Add more by number.
